pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to losing positions; pyramiding is authorized only after a minimum of +$10.00 unrealized profit is locked and moving averages align.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: No XAUUSD order execution is permitted without a minimum ATR(14) buffer of $1.50 spacing between entry price and the initial stop-loss to absorb microstructure wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops once profit exceeds +$8.00 to ensure run targets scale toward the $15-$30+ asymmetry bracket.
